title: task Implement Cognito-authenticated Apricity cloud CLI
description: Implement the approved authenticated CLI plan and its executable behavior specifications. Covers Cognito PKCE login/keychain session, Score CRUD with ScoreRef reconciliation, and curator/admin S3-library record import into AppSync.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Started implementation. Verified Plexus's real Cognito pattern: hosted authorization-code login with PKCE/state, loopback callback, keychain refresh-token store, automatic refresh, and revocation on logout. Apricity will adapt it to its 127.0.0.1:5181 callback and ID-token AppSync authorization.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented authenticated CLI commands: Cognito hosted-login PKCE/state loopback flow, OS-keychain refresh-token storage, automatic ID-token refresh, logout revocation, Score CRUD with reference reconciliation, and curator/admin Cognito-Identity-backed S3 library-record import. Verification:  passed 32 tests; workspace-wide rustfmt check was not used because it reports unrelated existing formatting drift.
